create.name: John J. Prendergast
create.bio:
John J. Prendergast is a nondual teacher and writer from the San Francisco Bay Area whose work joins psychological insight with the direct recognition of awareness. For many years he studied with the European sage Jean Klein and later with Adyashanti, began teaching in 2011 at the invitation of Dorothy Hunt, and in 2023 received formal authorisation to teach from Adyashanti. Alongside this he spent his career as a psychotherapist and taught counselling to graduate students at the California Institute of Integral Studies for more than two decades; he has since retired from both.

His teaching centres on what he calls the deep heart and our deepest ground: a felt sense of quiet, steady presence in the body that underlies the busy, judging mind. Talks are paired with guided meditations and meditative inquiry done in pairs, in which participants gently question the limiting beliefs they hold about themselves. Since 2015 he has led residential retreats with his wife, Christiane, who offers gentle movement and sensing practices in Jean Klein's style, in California and in Europe, and he teaches online series and hosts free monthly inquiry groups. His books include In Touch, The Deep Heart and Your Deepest Ground.

books.title: Your Deepest Ground: A Guide to Embodied Spirituality
books.author: John J. Prendergast
books.description: His fullest treatment of the ground: the settled, felt sense of being supported that makes it possible to live from the heart. It mixes personal stories with inquiries and short practices for finding that steadiness in the body.

books.title: The Deep Heart: Our Portal to Presence
books.author: John J. Prendergast
books.description: An experiential guide to the heart as a doorway into presence. Through meditative inquiries the reader learns to notice and loosen core beliefs about being unworthy or separate.

books.title: In Touch: How to Tune In to the Inner Guidance of Your Body and Trust Yourself
books.author: John J. Prendergast
books.description: A book about the body's quiet sense of what is true. Short experiments help readers tell inner knowing apart from habit and fear, and bring that attunement into choices and relationships.

courses.title: The Heart and Ground of Being: A Four Day Home Video Retreat
courses.description: About seventeen hours of filmed retreat sessions from 2025 with John and Christiane, including talks, guided meditations, inquiries and her movement sessions. Buyers get lasting access through his site and a discussion forum.

courses.title: Opening Up, Lining Up, and Lighting Up: The Subtle Somatic Dimension of Self-Recognition
courses.description: A six-week online series on Saturday mornings, hosted by Open Circle, looking at how the subtle body takes part in waking up. Sessions are recorded for anyone who misses one.

courses.title: The Sense of Inner Knowing
courses.description: A recorded course of seven ninety-minute sessions on recognising and trusting the body's inner sense of truth, sold through JungPlatform.

courses.title: Journey into the Deep Heart
courses.description: Six recorded sessions on opening to the heart as a centre of presence and intimacy, with guided inquiry, sold through JungPlatform.

courses.title: Opening to the Ground
courses.description: A four-session recorded course on finding a felt sense of steadiness and support beneath thought, sold through JungPlatform.

free_resources.title: Online Meditative Inquiry Group
free_resources.description: Free monthly drop-in meetings on Zoom in several time zones, each with a recorded meditation by John, inquiry in pairs and group sharing. Best for people who already know his books or programmes.

free_resources.title: Falling Open (Open Circle series recordings)
free_resources.description: Free recordings of a four-part online series from 2024 on falling open to not knowing, to wholeness and to the ground of being. This link opens the first session; the others are listed on his online courses page.
